name: triad-dr
description: Drives use of the decision registers — ADR (Builder), IDR (Investor), MDR (Seller) — plus an escalation queue where automated workers park decisions they are not authorized to make. Five commands for the rituals that keep a register worth reading: write a killable bet, judge one at its review date, record a decision under the bet that funds it, answer what agents are blocked on, and see what is overdue or ungoverned. Surfaces blocked workers and past-due bets at session start. Reads and prompts; never writes a decision record on its own.
